Loading the data, packages 

```{r}
install.packages("multiverse")
install.packages("dplyr")
install.packages("Matrix")
install.packages("lmerTest")
install.packages("knitr")
install.packages("tidyr")


library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(Matrix)
library(lmerTest)
library(multiverse)
library(ggplot2)
if (!require("broom")) install.packages("broom") 
library(broom)

raw_data = read_csv("data/edge1.1.csv")
game = multiverse()

particip_data_duplicates = raw_data %>%  
  dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters) %>%  
  group_by(ThreadId, Id, ) %>%
  summarize(across(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor,  ~ paste(unique(.x), collapse = "; "))) 
        
 particip_data_filt = particip_data_duplicates %>% 
  filter(if_any(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor, ~ grepl(";", .x)))
 
 raw_data = anti_join(raw_data, particip_data_filt,  by = c("ThreadId", "Id"))
 
 particip_data_clean = raw_data %>%  
   dplyr::select(!Order:Number.Characters) %>% 
  group_by(ThreadId, Id) %>%
  summarize(across(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor, unique))

raw_data_n = raw_data %>%  
  group_by(ThreadId) %>%  
  dplyr::select(!Live) %>%  
  summarise(across(Male_Contributions:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique))
```



Attempt on trying a data_filtering decision with the multiverse 

```{multiverse default-m-1, inside = game}
data_st1 = raw_data  %>%  
  dplyr::select(branch(level, 
                       "participant" ~ !c(Order:Number.Characters), 
                       "conversation" ~ !Live )) %>% 
  group_by(ThreadId, Type, branch(level, 
                            "participant" ~ Id, 
                            "conversation" ~ NULL))  %>%  
  summarise(branch(level, 
                   "participant" ~ across(Male_Contributions:ContributionsbyAuthor, unique),
                    "conversation" ~ across(Male_Contributions:UniqueFemaleParticipation, unique)))


parameters(game)
```


Few plots, just to check whether it works

```{multiverse default-m-3, inside = game}
data_filtered = data_variables %>% 
  dplyr::filter(branch(n_female_male, 
                "only_female" ~ UniqueFemaleContributors >= 1, 
                "female_and_male" ~ UniqueFemaleContributors >= 1 & UniqueMaleContributors >= 1))
```

```{multiverse default-m-4, inside = game}
data_filtered2 = data_filtered %>%  
  filter(branch(questions, 
                "questions_and_comments" ~ Type == Type, 
                "only_comments" ~ Type == 2))
```
